item.name: sticky-scroll-story
item.summary: scroll-section: Sticky media column with scrolling steps (dom, server-safe, CLS <= 0.01, reduced motion -> opacity-only (instant swap), mobile -> stacked)

useWhen: Editorial feature walk-throughs with accompanying media illustrations
Product showcase stories highlighting sequential capabilities
Multi-step walkthroughs where media changes as user reads through text
avoidWhen: Short single-paragraph descriptions without multi-step progression
Galleries where media should scroll freely rather than remain sticky

alternatives.name: scroll-reveal
alternatives.when: When revealing standalone cards or sections without pinned media

tiers.0: Not gated by tier: sticky two-column layout above 768px, stacked at 768px and below (same at every tier)
tiers.1: Same as tier 0; layout depends on viewport width, not tier
tiers.2: Same as tier 0; layout depends on viewport width, not tier
tiers.3: Same as tier 0; layout depends on viewport width, not tier

reducedMotion.description: Media swaps are instant (inactive media is hidden with opacity 0 and transitions are disabled, so there is no fade); no translation or parallax. Server HTML keeps all media visible.

input.pointer: None; active step is driven solely by scroll position (IntersectionObserver)
input.touch: Stacked layout at viewport width 768px and below, with media shown inline under each step
input.keyboard: Native focus order and keyboard scrolling; the component adds no focusable elements

a11y.notes: DOM order matches reading order. The active step has aria-current='step'. Image media (media.type 'image') gets alt from media.alt, falling back to the step title. Custom media (media.content) gets no alt: supply accessible text inside the content yourself. Each step's media is rendered twice (sticky column and inline mobile copy); only one is visible at a time.

props.name: steps
props.effect: Required. Array of { id: string; title: string; description: string; badge?: string; media: { type?: "image" | "custom"; src?: string; alt?: string; content?: React.ReactNode } }.

props.name: mediaPosition
props.effect: Alignment of the sticky media column relative to the text narrative.

props.name: onStepChange
props.effect: Optional. No default. Called with the step id when a step becomes active.

props.name: paused
props.effect: Universal pause prop. Stops tracking the scrolled step: the active step stays where it is.

props.name: nonce
props.effect: Optional CSP nonce forwarded to the internal scoped <style> element.

props.name: className
props.effect: Optional CSS class names to apply to root container.

props.name: style
props.effect: Optional. No default. Inline styles for the root container.

mistakes: Do not attach window scroll listeners to calculate sticky step progress; StickyScrollStory uses IntersectionObserver.
Do not invert DOM order; reading order must match step sequence for assistive technology.
media.alt is only used when media.type is 'image'; for custom media put accessible text inside media.content.
The inactive-media hiding only applies under html[data-motion="ok"] (MotionReadyScript in Next, initMotionReady() in Vite) or after hydration with reduced motion.
Each step's media.content is rendered twice (sticky column and stacked mobile copy): no ids inside it. Step titles are h2 elements; put your section heading above them accordingly.
verify: Verify mobile layout (<= 768px) cleanly stacks steps and media without sticky jumps.
Verify aria-current='step' updates as steps scroll through the viewport center.
